actionResult.summary: F1 proof-based Explore completed. F1 is the legal next Change after E1 checkpoint, but F1 Apply must only implement reusable Delivery Finalize/Delivery Final capability; it must not finalize 03 while G1/H1 remain planned and Full Test/Actual are not final-ready. Explore proved two current fail-open gaps: authorize-delivery-finalize is delivery-scoped without exact final-candidate qualification so an old authorization can be reused after fresh Full Test/architecture cycles, and Git Delivery Final recognition currently accepts loose subject-only commits without formal trailers/Owner admission. A deterministic qualification identity derived from current Full Test occurrence plus architecture disposition, minimal no-Run completed/finalization projection, crash-reconstructible Git handoff, strict candidate->point-in-time Manifest/Owner admission, bounded historical compatibility, Merge Commit topology expectation, and F1 verification physical closure are all feasible without auto commit/push/merge or a new evidence/registry platform.
